maddeler.e:
تستشهدي (form X)
# تَسْتَشْهِدِي (tastašhidī) /tas.taʃ.hi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# تُسْتَشْهَدِي (tustašhadī) /tus.taʃ.ha.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
